title: Nutty X-tra Crisp Algerian Sausage Tagine
description: A nutty, crisp Algerian dish featuring sausage, perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pomegranate molasses, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Return the sausage to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the toasted almonds and parsley, and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cilantro and serve hot.
